source.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
source.title: Addressing the local audit backlog in England: Non-compliance lists
source.scope: Lists of bodies that did not publish by the relevant backstop, not a census. A missing row is not evidence of anything. Pension fund entries are separate from main council accounts.
source.discrepancy: The first table has 67 body rows although publisher prose says 68 bodies. No row is added.
source.transformation: Identity labels and table membership only. No personal names, audit firm names or per-body PSAA values. Labels retain the research spelling; in the Merton pension fund label the original dash is represented by two spaces, to, two spaces. No other label change.

evidence.quote: “the North Yorkshire Council” means the council of the county of North Yorkshire;
evidence.note: The North Yorkshire (Structural Changes) Order 2022, SI 2022/328, article 2. Article 3(1) makes this continuing council the sole principal authority on or after 1 April 2023. Article 3(3) provides for omitting county from its name by resolution. Raw legislation.gov.uk XML read on the retrieval date. H2, decided on 19 November 2026, authorises this same-body attachment with the label as printed.

evidence.quote: shall be known as “The North Yorkshire Council” from Vesting Day on 1 April 2023
evidence.note: New Constitution for North Yorkshire Council, official minutes. The resolved name and date fulfil the condition in article 3(3). This is the continuing county council under a new name, not a predecessor or successor assignment.
